------------------------------------------------------------------------

title: "urbanity_autocorrelation"


###1.0 cleaning data
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(sfdep)     # 用于 (双变量) 局部 Moran
library(tmap)
set.seed(2023)

# 1. read in saved dataset in last step
epc_path <- "epc_panel.csv"

epc <- read_csv(epc_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(ladcode = as.character(ladcode),
         year    = as.integer(year))

epc <- epc |>
  mutate(
    pct_efg   = pct_e + pct_f + pct_g,
    pct_abcd  = pct_a + pct_b + pct_c + pct_d,
    pct_bcd   = pct_b + pct_c + pct_d
  )

geo_sf <-  st_read("Local_Authority_Districts_May_2024_Boundaries_UK_BFC_-6788913184658251542.geojson")


library(dplyr)
geo_sf <- geo_sf %>%
  rename(ladcode = LAD24CD)

g <- geo_sf |> left_join(epc, by = "ladcode")
urbanity_panel <- g |>
  select(ladcode, co2_per_1000p, urbanity,pct_efg, geometry, pct_bcd,)

```



```{r}
# 1) preparing the dataset
g <- g |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  filter(!is.na(urbanity), !is.na(co2_per_1000p))
urbanity_panel <- g |>
  select(ladcode, co2_per_1000p, urbanity,pct_efg, geometry, pct_bcd,)

# 2) kNN=4
coords <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(urbanity_panel)))
nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 4))
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")

# 2. checking all variables are available
valid <- !is.na(urbanity_panel$co2_per_1000p) & !is.na(urbanity_panel$urbanity)

# 3. standardise all 
y <- scale(urbanity_panel$co2_per_1000p[valid])[,1]
x <- scale(urbanity_panel$urbanity[valid])[,1]

# 4. creating spatial weights 
nb_sub <- spdep::subset.nb(nb, subset = valid)
lw_sub <- nb2listw(nb_sub, style = "W")


lag_x <- spdep::lag.listw(lw_sub, x, zero.policy = TRUE)



```


```{r}
# === 1) 全局双变量 Moran's I：I_xy = (n/S0) * sum( y_i * sum_j w_ij x_j ) ===
nsim <- 999
n  <- sum(valid); S0 <- spdep::Szero(lw_sub)
I_obs <- (n / S0) * sum(y * lag_x)

I_perm <- replicate(nsim, {
  x_perm <- sample(x, replace = FALSE)
  lag_perm <- spdep::lag.listw(lw_sub, x_perm, zero.policy = TRUE)
  (n / S0) * sum(y * lag_perm)
})
p_perm <- (sum(abs(I_perm) >= abs(I_obs)) + 1) / (nsim + 1)
cat(sprintf("Global bivariate Moran's I (CO2 ~ lag(urbanity)): I_xy = %.3f, perm p = %.4f\n",
            I_obs, p_perm))

```
